events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. Please note: There is no chess club on Sat Nov 21 for our Big Fall Book Sale This is a drop-in program.

Bring your homework and enjoy a snack in a space that is just for teens. This program is part of Youth Hub service. events.title: Youth Hub: DIY Mindful Sticker Art
events.description: Join us for a creative and relaxing experience as you design your own mindful sticker scene art! You’ll have the opportunity to choose from a variety of themed sticker scenes and create your own unique artwork while enjoying a calming, stress-free environment. This program is part of Youth Hub service. events.title: Port Union Chess Club
events.description: Looking for a fun after-school activity? Join our Youth Chess Program to learn new skills, play matches, and connect with others!  This program is open to youth ages 7-17 years old. Facilitated by the University of Toronto Scarborough Chess Club. No registration required. Space is limited.

events.title: Drop In Chess Club
events.description: Come and join chess players of all ages for drop in Chess Club!  All levels are welcome.  Bring your own board or use one of ours.

events.title: Lunch @ the Library
events.description: Looking for something fun to do at lunch? Join us at Riverdale Library every Tuesday and Thursday for games, creative activities, crafts, and more. Meet up with friends, relax, and have fun all lunch period long. Drop in. For teens only.

events.title: Knitting and Crochet Circle
events.description: Spend an afternoon at our weekly drop-in knitting and crochet circle! Bring your work in progress and enjoy visiting with other knitters and crocheters. A great place to show off your work, get advice, swap ideas, or just relax and visit with fellow fiber enthusiasts. Beginners and all ages welcome! A limited supply of materials will be available.

events.title: Youth Hub: Pomodoro Study Hall
events.description: Join us for a focused study session using the Pomodoro Technique. Perfect for teens looking to boost productivity and stay on track with their schoolwork. This program is part of Youth Hub service. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily. Drop by a branch with a Youth Hub or call the branch to find out more.

events.title: Youth Hub: Crafty Thursdays
events.description: Join us in the Youth Hub every Thursday for a series of crafting activities like painting, clay sculpting, sewing and embroidery, resin art, jewelry making, perler beads, block printing, and more! Check tpl.ca or our monthly calendar for the activity of the week. All materials provided. This program is part of Youth Hub service. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily.

events.title: Chess Club
events.description: Drop in for a casual game of chess in a welcoming environment. Improve your chess skills or learn how to play. Sets are provided. All ages. Drop-in.

events.title: Youth Hub: Board Games
events.description: Drop-in casual board game social. This program is part of Youth Hub service. Youth Hubs are a welcoming place for teens after school and in the summer, where helpful staff are always available. Free, nutritious snacks are offered daily. Drop by a branch with a Youth Hub or call the branch to find out more. events.title: Youth Hub: Intermediate Dungeons & Dragons
events.description: Join us every other Thursday in the Youth Hub as we delve into perilous dungeons and thwart evil plots in an on-going Dungeons & Dragons campaign! This is an ongoing adventure at an intermediate level. Players will need to have a character sheet prepared for fifth level. Space is limited to six players, but guests and spectators are also welcome! This program is part of Youth Hub service. events.title: The Art of DJ-ing
events.description: Meet Benjamin, Artist in the Library at the Downsview Branch, where you will learn the Art of Dj-ing. Every Thursday with special guests, learn the skills required to blend, beat match and mix tracks while also learning about future career opportunities. Students will learn equipment mastery, have fun and learn how to build a brand on social media. This event is part of the  Artists in the Library program. Benjamin with DJ equipment

events.title: Image Editing for Beginners with Photoshop 2
events.description: Adobe Photoshop is one of the world’s leading imaging and graphic design software and is at the core of just about every creative project, from photo editing and compositing to digital painting, animation, and graphic design. Continuing from Image Editing for Beginners with Photoshop beginners will be using Photoshop to alter and correct photos using the tools learned from the previous class as well seeing how the Mask tool works. events.title: Saturday Chess Club
events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. Please note: There is no chess club on Sat Nov 21 for our Big Fall Book Sale This is a drop-in program.

events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.

events.title: Silent Book Club
events.description: Join us on the first Tuesday of the month for Silent Book Club. Bring your own book, or choose something from our collection, and spend some time silently reading together. Afterwards, we'll all discuss what we were reading together! Drop in, no registration required!
